svg.title: L2 Services -- Adobe Commerce on AWS
svg.desc: Route 53 resolves shoppers to CloudFront behind AWS WAF. A public load balancer spreads requests over Varnish, an internal one over the Magento servers, which use OpenSearch, ElastiCache for Redis, Aurora and EFS across two Availability Zones.
